# 00000007938

**INT-08 ★** — source: 250_可积系统II.md

**English.** Definition: The isotropic lattice of Backlund transforms: the tree T_D generated by iterating Darboux transforms of integrable PDEs such as sine-Gordon. Conjecture: The automorphism group of T_D is the corresponding affine Weyl group W; the composition law of transforms admits a perfect coloring of shortest representative lengths l(w) with l(w) = depth(w) (a cyclic structure of the dual Coxeter number h); and the node count of the isotropic lattice at depth d is the Poincare polynomial product of (1+...+q^{m_i}) (m_i the exponents of W). (Backlund tree affine Weyl symmetry)

**中文。** 定义：Bäcklund 变换的迷向格：可积 PDE（如 sine-Gordon）的 Darboux 变换的迭代生成的树 T_D。猜想：T_D 的自同构群为相应仿射 Weyl 群 W；且变换的合成律的合成字的最短代表字长 ℓ(w) 满足 ℓ(w) = depth(w) 的完美染色（双 Coxeter 数 h 的循环结构）；迷向格的节点计数在深度 d 为 Poincaré 多项式 Π(1+…+q^{m_i})（m_i 为 W 的指数）。
